name: layout-designer
$tagsComment: Tier 6 of docs/business-apps/architecture.md, the designer in the shell: phase 6's first two slices. A feature, not an engine: it draws with the record page and form engines (libs/shared/document-layouts) and the queue engine (libs/shared/queues), and checks with the app definition's validator (libs/shared/app-definition), and nothing depends on it but the app.

typecheck.$comment: ngc, not tsc: it compiles the templates with strictTemplates too. The spec files are type-checked by the spec-types gate through tsconfig.spec.json.
